title: Obsidian-Intelligence Layer — Stabilization + Autonomous Workflows + HTML Outputs + Company Brain + IdeaBlock RAG + Capture Surfaces + Agent Observability
brief: Atomized envelope synthesized from OBSIDIAN-INTELLIGENCE-MS3-UNIFIED-PLAN.md (claude-cee63f1f, 2026-05-09). 24 units across 7 tracks. Track A (stabilization, 2u) unblocks everything by killing xmalloc OOMs via persistent prism-hooks Docker broker + finishing the Write|Edit|MultiEdit matcher on the reread-signal hook. Track B (6 autonomous workflows from cyrilXBT) ships compounding daily/weekly value via Daily Context, Connection Finder, Queue Processor, Weekly Synthesis, Project Auto-Updater, Knowledge Distillation. Track C (3 HTML outputs from Thariq/Anthropic playbook) makes Claude-generated reports info-dense + interactive (no more 100-line markdown walls). Track D (5 Company Brain units from Sentra/Ashwin reframe) adds provenance, ontology, conflict resolution, action traces, and context-evaluation gates — the BIG architectural shift. Track E (4 IdeaBlock RAG units from Akshay Pachaar/Blockify pattern) replaces chunk-window retrieval with question+validated-answer atomic blocks (~40x corpus reduction, ~2.3x retrieval relevance). Track F (2 capture surfaces) ships voice memo watcher + PDF highlights-only ingest. Track G (3 agent observability from darkzodchi 3-rule playbook) adds narrow job descriptions + pixel-dept overlay + runtime alerts. Sources: 5 X articles fetched via jina reader (state/shared/x-fetch/), 6 shipped OBSIDIAN-VIZ-MS0 units, 3 in-flight MS2 units, U-DOCKER-HOOK-BROKER handoff. Original spec: state/shared/specs/OBSIDIAN-INTELLIGENCE-MS3-UNIFIED-PLAN.md.

exit_conditions: ContextEvalEngine compares retrieved-set vs ideal-set on every memory action

Coverage drop > threshold → BLOCK (shop_floor) | WARN (default)
PreToolUse hook fires evaluator on memory:semantic_search responses

phases.title: IdeaBlock RAG (Akshay/Blockify pattern)
phases.rationale: Chunk-window is the wrong retrieval unit. IdeaBlocks = question + validated-answer + governance fields. ~40x corpus reduction + 2.3x retrieval relevance + 13.55% accuracy gain. Direct upgrade path for ObsidianMemoryRagEngine.

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-EXTRACTOR — convert memory/wiki .md → IdeaBlocks via Ollama structured output (qwen2.5-coder:7b)
exit_conditions: IdeaBlock schema: { question, answer(2-3 sentences), source_path, source_offset, governance_tags[] }
Ollama structured-output JSON mode used
1 .md → N IdeaBlocks (one per atomic claim)
Test: 5 fixture .md files produce expected ≥10 IdeaBlocks with valid schema
units.rollback: Stop extraction; existing IdeaBlocks remain as inert JSONL

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-DEDUP — iterative cosine-similarity dedup at 80-85% threshold, 3-5 rounds, collapses near-duplicates
exit_conditions: Dedup uses Qdrant cosine similarity over IdeaBlock embeddings
Configurable threshold (default 0.82) and max rounds (default 4)
Per round: cluster → merge canonical → re-embed → re-cluster
Convergence detection: zero new merges in a round
Test: synthetic duplicate corpus collapses to expected canonical count
units.rollback: Skip dedup; IdeaBlocks remain raw extraction set

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-RAG-ENGINE — replace ObsidianMemoryRagEngine chunk-window retrieval with IdeaBlock matching
exit_conditions: New IdeaBlockRagEngine implements same public API as ObsidianMemoryRagEngine (drop-in)
Retrieval returns ranked IdeaBlocks with answer + source link
Expected ≥2x retrieval relevance vs chunk-window baseline (measured via fixed eval queries)
Test: 20-query eval set shows relevance lift; A/B against old engine
units.rollback: Switch dispatcher back to ObsidianMemoryRagEngine via singleton swap

units.title: U-IDEABLOCK-GOVERNANCE — auto-tag each block with clearance | version-state | product-line | export-control
exit_conditions: Governance tags machine-applied (not author-applied) via Ollama classifier
Tags enum: clearance ∈ {public,internal,confidential} | version_state ∈ {current,deprecated,draft} | product_line ∈ {sfc,master-post,cad-cam-ai,...} | export_control ∈ {none,EAR,ITAR}
Tags persisted in IdeaBlock frontmatter
Test: known-clearance fixture corpus classified at ≥85% accuracy
units.rollback: Stop tagging; existing tags remain
